```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer $left
     * @param Integer $right
     * @return String
     */
    function abbreviateProduct($left, $right) {
        $mant = 1.0;
        $exp = 0;
        $a = 0; // count of 2s
        $b = 0; // count of 5s
        $r = 1; // product of cores mod 10^5
        
        for ($i = $left; $i <= $right; $i++) {
            $mant *= $i;
            while ($mant >= 10.0) {
                $mant /= 10.0;
                $exp++;
            }
            $x = $i;
            while ($x % 2 === 0) { $x = intdiv($x, 2); $a++; }
            while ($x % 5 === 0) { $x = intdiv($x, 5); $b++; }
            $r = ($r * $x) % 100000;
        }
        
        $C = min($a, $b);
        $d = $exp - $C + 1;
        
        if ($d <= 10) {
            $stripped = (int) round($mant * pow(10.0, $exp - $C));
            return $stripped . 'e' . $C;
        }
        
        // d > 10: pre = first 5 digits, suf = last 5 digits
        $pre = (int) ($mant * 10000.0);
        if ($pre < 10000) $pre = 10000;
        if ($pre > 99999) $pre = 99999;
        
        if ($a > $b) {
            $s = $this->powMod(2, $a - $b, 100000);
        } else {
            $s = $this->powMod(5, $b - $a, 100000);
        }
        $suf = ($r * $s) % 100000;
        
        return $pre . '...' . str_pad((string)$suf, 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT) . 'e' . $C;
    }
    
    private function powMod($base, $exp, $mod) {
        $result = 1;
        $base = $base % $mod;
        while ($exp > 0) {
            if ($exp & 1) {
                $result = ($result * $base) % $mod;
            }
            $base = ($base * $base) % $mod;
            $exp = $exp >> 1;
        }
        return $result;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer $left
     * @param Integer $right
     * @return String
     */
    function abbreviateProduct($left, $right) {
        $mant = 1.0;
        $exp = 0;
        $c2 = 0;
        $c5 = 0;
        $r = 1;
        
        for ($i = $left; $i <= $right; $i++) {
            $mant *= $i;
            while ($mant >= 10.0) {
                $mant = $mant / 10.0;
                $exp++;
            }
            $x = $i;
            while ($x % 2 === 0) { $x = intdiv($x, 2); $c2++; }
            while ($x % 5 === 0) { $x = intdiv($x, 5); $c5++; }
            if ($x > 1) {
                $r = ($r * $x) % 100000;
            }
        }
        
        $zeros = min($c2, $c5);
        $d = $exp - $zeros + 1;
        
        if ($d <= 10) {
            $p = 1.0;
            for ($j = 0; $j < $exp - $zeros; $j++) $p *= 10.0;
            $stripped = (int) round($mant * $p);
            return $stripped . 'e' . $zeros;
        }
        
        $pre = (int) ($mant * 10000.0);
        if ($pre < 10000) $pre = 10000;
        elseif ($pre > 99999) $pre = 99999;
        
        if ($c2 > $c5) {
            $s = $this->powMod(2, $c2 - $c5, 100000);
        } else {
            $s = $this->powMod(5, $c5 - $c2, 100000);
        }
        $suf = ($r * $s) % 100000;
        
        return $pre . '...' . str_pad((string)$suf, 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT) . 'e' . $zeros;
    }
    
    private function powMod($b, $e, $m) {
        $res = 1 % $m;
        $b = $b % $m;
        while ($e > 0) {
            if ($e & 1) $res = ($res * $b) % $m;
            $b = ($b * $b) % $m;
            $e = $e >> 1;
        }
        return $res;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer $left
     * @param Integer $right
     * @return String
     */
    function abbreviateProduct($left, $right) {
        $mant = 1.0;
        $exp = 0;
        $c2 = 0;
        $c5 = 0;
        $r = 1;

        for ($i = $left; $i <= $right; $i++) {
            // leading digits: keep mantissa in [1, 10)
            $mant *= $i;
            while ($mant >= 10.0) {
                $mant /= 10.0;
                $exp++;
            }
            // count factors of 2 and 5; track rest mod 1e5 for suffix
            $x = $i;
            while ($x % 2 === 0) { $x = intdiv($x, 2); $c2++; }
            while ($x % 5 === 0) { $x = intdiv($x, 5); $c5++; }
            if ($x > 1) {
                $r = ($r * $x) % 100000;
            }
        }

        $zeros = min($c2, $c5);
        $d = $exp - $zeros + 1;

        if ($d <= 10) {
            $p = 1.0;
            for ($j = 0; $j < $exp - $zeros; $j++) {
                $p *= 10.0;
            }
            $stripped = (int) round($mant * $p);
            return $stripped . 'e' . $zeros;
        }

        // first 5 digits
        $pre = (int) ($mant * 10000.0);
        if ($pre < 10000) {
            $pre = 10000;
        } elseif ($pre > 99999) {
            $pre = 99999;
        }

        // last 5 digits: stripped = 2^(c2-zeros) * 5^(c5-zeros) * R
        if ($c2 > $c5) {
            $b = 2;
            $e = $c2 - $c5;
        } else {
            $b = 5;
            $e = $c5 - $c2;
        }
        $s = 1;
        while ($e > 0) {
            if ($e & 1) {
                $s = ($s * $b) % 100000;
            }
            $b = ($b * $b) % 100000;
            $e >>= 1;
        }
        $suf = ($r * $s) % 100000;

        return $pre . '...' . str_pad((string) $suf, 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT) . 'e' . $zeros;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer $left
     * @param Integer $right
     * @return String
     */
    function abbreviateProduct($left, $right) {
        $mant = 1.0;
        $exp = 0;
        $c2 = 0;
        $c5 = 0;
        $r = 1;

        for ($i = $left; $i <= $right; $i++) {
            $mant *= $i;
            while ($mant >= 10.0) {
                $mant /= 10.0;
                $exp++;
            }
            $x = $i;
            while ($x % 2 === 0) {
                $x = intdiv($x, 2);
                $c2++;
            }
            while ($x % 5 === 0) {
                $x = intdiv($x, 5);
                $c5++;
            }
            if ($x > 1) {
                $r = ($r * $x) % 100000;
            }
        }

        $zeros = min($c2, $c5);
        $d = $exp - $zeros + 1;

        if ($d <= 10) {
            $p = 1.0;
            for ($j = 0; $j < $exp - $zeros; $j++) {
                $p *= 10.0;
            }
            $stripped = (int) round($mant * $p);
            return $stripped . 'e' . $zeros;
        }

        $pre = (int) ($mant * 10000.0);
        if ($pre < 10000) {
            $pre = 10000;
        } elseif ($pre > 99999) {
            $pre = 99999;
        }

        if ($c2 > $c5) {
            $b = 2;
            $e = $c2 - $c5;
        } else {
            $b = 5;
            $e = $c5 - $c2;
        }
        $s = 1;
        while ($e > 0) {
            if ($e & 1) {
                $s = ($s * $b) % 100000;
            }
            $b = ($b * $b) % 100000;
            $e >>= 1;
        }
        $suf = ($r * $s) % 100000;

        return $pre . '...' . str_pad((string) $suf, 5, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT) . 'e' . $zeros;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {
    function maximumBeauty($flowers, $newFlowers, $target, $full, $partial) {
        sort($flowers); // ascending
        $n = count($flowers);
        // find idx = first index with flowers[i] >= target
        // prefix sums
        $pre = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) $pre[$i+1] = $pre[$i] + $flowers[$i];
        
        // idx: first index with flowers[idx] >= target (binary search or linear)
        $idx = $n;
        // binary search: first >= target
        $lo = 0; $hi = $n;
        while ($lo < $hi) {
            $mid = intdiv($lo + $hi, 2);
            if ($flowers[$mid] >= $target) $hi = $mid; else $lo = $mid + 1;
        }
        $idx = $lo;
        
        $C = $target - 1;
        $ans = 0;
        
        // iterate k from 0 to idx
        for ($k = 0; $k <= $idx; $k++) {
            // cost to complete v[idx-k .. idx-1]
            $cost = $k * $target - ($pre[$idx] - $pre[$idx - $k]);
            if ($cost > $newFlowers) break;
            $R = $newFlowers - $cost;
            $j = $idx - $k; // pool size: v[0..j-1]
            // compute L*
            if ($j == 0) {
                $L = 0;
            } else {
                // g(t) = t*v[t] - pre[t] for t in [0..j-1]; g(j) = j*C - pre[j]
                // find largest t in [0..j] with g(t) <= R
                // binary search
                $lo = 0; $hi = $j;
                // g is non-decreasing on [0..j]
                while ($lo < $hi) {
                    $mid = intdiv($lo + $hi + 1, 2);
                    $g = ($mid < $j) ? $mid * $flowers[$mid] - $pre[$mid] : $j * $C - $pre[$j];
                    if ($g <= $R) $lo = $mid; else $hi = $mid - 1;
                }
                $t0 = $lo;
                if ($t0 == 0) {
                    $L = $flowers[0]; // = v[0]
                    // Actually also could be max(v[0], floor((R + pre[1])/1)) if j >= 1... 
                    // wait, t0 = 0 means g(1) > R. Then floor((R+pre[1])/1) = R + v[0] < v[1]... 
                    // hmm, g(1) = v[1] - v[0] > R means v[1] - v[0] > R, so R + v[0] < v[1]. 
                    // L* = max(v[0], R + v[0]) = R + v[0] if R > 0 else v[0]. 
                    // Wait! If t0 = 0 and R > 0, we can raise garden 0 to v[0] + R (as long as < v[1]). 
                    // Since g(1) > R means v[1] > v[0] + R, so v[0] + R < v[1], valid! 
                    // So L* = v[0] + R, not v[0]!
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {
    /**
     * @param Integer[] $flowers
     * @param Integer $newFlowers
     * @param Integer $target
     * @param Integer $full
     * @param Integer $partial
     * @return Integer
     */
    function maximumBeauty($flowers, $newFlowers, $target, $full, $partial) {
        sort($flowers);
        $n = count($flowers);
        
        // prefix sums
        $pre = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $pre[$i + 1] = $pre[$i] + $flowers[$i];
        }
        
        // idx = first index with flowers[idx] >= target
        $lo = 0; $hi = $n;
        while ($lo < $hi) {
            $mid = ($lo + $hi) >> 1;
            if ($flowers[$mid] >= $target) $hi = $mid; else $lo = $mid + 1;
        }
        $idx = $lo;
        
        $C = $target - 1;
        $ans = 0;
        
        for ($k = 0; $k <= $idx; $k++) {
            $cost = $k * $target - ($pre[$idx] - $pre[$idx - $k]);
            if ($cost > $newFlowers) break;
            $R = $newFlowers - $cost;
            $j = $idx - $k;
            
            if ($j == 0) {
                $L = 0;
            } else {
                // find t0 = max t in [0..j] with g(t) <= R
                // g(t) = t*v[t] - pre[t] for t < j; g(j) = j*C - pre[j]
                $lo = 0; $hi = $j;
                while ($lo < $hi) {
                    $mid = ($lo + $hi + 1) >> 1;
                    if ($mid < $j) {
                        $g = $mid * $flowers[$mid] - $pre[$mid];
                    } else {
                        $g = $j * $C - $pre[$j];
                    }
                    if ($g <= $R) $lo = $mid; else $hi = $mid - 1;
                }
                $t0 = $lo;
                if ($t0 == $j) {
                    $L = $C;
                } else {
                    $t1 = $t0 + 1;
                    $U = ($t1 < $j) ? $flowers[$t1] : $C;
                    $cand = intdiv($R + $pre[$t1], $t1);
                    if ($cand > $U) $cand = $U;
                    $L = max($flowers[$t0], $cand);
                }
            }
            
            $beauty = ($n - $j) * $full + $L * $partial;
            if ($beauty > $ans) $ans = $beauty;
        }
        
        return $ans;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer[] $flowers
     * @param Integer $newFlowers
     * @param Integer $target
     * @param Integer $full
     * @param Integer $partial
     * @return Integer
     */
    function maximumBeauty($flowers, $newFlowers, $target, $full, $partial) {
        sort($flowers);
        $n = count($flowers);

        $pre = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $pre[$i + 1] = $pre[$i] + $flowers[$i];
        }

        // idx: first index with flowers[idx] >= target
        $lo = 0;
        $hi = $n;
        while ($lo < $hi) {
            $mid = ($lo + $hi) >> 1;
            if ($flowers[$mid] >= $target) {
                $hi = $mid;
            } else {
                $lo = $mid + 1;
            }
        }
        $idx = $lo;

        $C = $target - 1;
        $ans = 0;

        for ($k = 0; $k <= $idx; $k++) {
            $cost = $k * $target - ($pre[$idx] - $pre[$idx - $k]);
            if ($cost > $newFlowers) {
                break;
            }
            $R = $newFlowers - $cost;
            $j = $idx - $k;

            if ($j == 0) {
                $L = 0;
            } else {
                // t0 = max t in [0..j] with g(t) <= R
                $lo = 0;
                $hi = $j;
                while ($lo < $hi) {
                    $mid = ($lo + $hi + 1) >> 1;
                    if ($mid < $j) {
                        $g = $mid * $flowers[$mid] - $pre[$mid];
                    } else {
                        $g = $j * $C - $pre[$j];
                    }
                    if ($g <= $R) {
                        $lo = $mid;
                    } else {
                        $hi = $mid - 1;
                    }
                }
                $t0 = $lo;
                if ($t0 == $j) {
                    $L = $C;
                } else {
                    $t1 = $t0 + 1;
                    $U = ($t1 < $j) ? $flowers[$t1] : $C;
                    $cand = intdiv($R + $pre[$t1], $t1);
                    if ($cand > $U) {
                        $cand = $U;
                    }
                    $L = max($flowers[$t0], $cand);
                }
            }

            $beauty = ($n - $j) * $full + $L * $partial;
            if ($beauty > $ans) {
                $ans = $beauty;
            }
        }

        return $ans;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer[] $flowers
     * @param Integer $newFlowers
     * @param Integer $target
     * @param Integer $full
     * @param Integer $partial
     * @return Integer
     */
    function maximumBeauty($flowers, $newFlowers, $target, $full, $partial) {
        sort($flowers);
        $n = count($flowers);

        // prefix sums
        $pre = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $pre[$i + 1] = $pre[$i] + $flowers[$i];
        }

        // idx: first index whose flowers >= target (these are complete already)
        $lo = 0;
        $hi = $n;
        while ($lo < $hi) {
            $mid = ($lo + $hi) >> 1;
            if ($flowers[$mid] >= $target) {
                $hi = $mid;
            } else {
                $lo = $mid + 1;
            }
        }
        $idx = $lo;

        $cap = $target - 1;
        $ans = 0;

        // k = number of additional (below-target) gardens made complete
        for ($k = 0; $k <= $idx; $k++) {
            $cost = $k * $target - ($pre[$idx] - $pre[$idx - $k]);
            if ($cost > $newFlowers) {
                break;
            }
            $rem = $newFlowers - $cost;
            $j = $idx - $k; // incomplete gardens: flowers[0..j-1]

            if ($j == 0) {
                $minLevel = 0;
            } else {
                // largest t in [0..j] with g(t) <= rem,
                // g(t) = t*flowers[t] - pre[t] (t < j), g(j) = j*cap - pre[j]
                $lo = 0;
                $hi = $j;
                while ($lo < $hi) {
                    $mid = ($lo + $hi + 1) >> 1;
                    if ($mid < $j) {
                        $g = $mid * $flowers[$mid] - $pre[$mid];
                    } else {
                        $g = $j * $cap - $pre[$j];
                    }
                    if ($g <= $rem) {
                        $lo = $mid;
                    } else {
                        $hi = $mid - 1;
                    }
                }
                $t = $lo;
                if ($t == $j) {
                    $minLevel = $cap;
                } else {
                    $t1 = $t + 1;
                    $upper = ($t1 < $j) ? $flowers[$t1] : $cap;
                    $cand = intdiv($rem + $pre[$t1], $t1);
                    if ($cand > $upper) {
                        $cand = $upper;
                    }
                    $minLevel = max($flowers[$t], $cand);
                }
            }

            $beauty = ($n - $j) * $full + $minLevel * $partial;
            if ($beauty > $ans) {
                $ans = $beauty;
            }
        }

        return $ans;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer[] $flowers
     * @param Integer $newFlowers
     * @param Integer $target
     * @param Integer $full
     * @param Integer $partial
     * @return Integer
     */
    function maximumBeauty($flowers, $newFlowers, $target, $full, $partial) {
        sort($flowers);
        $n = count($flowers);

        $pre = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $pre[$i + 1] = $pre[$i] + $flowers[$i];
        }

        $lo = 0;
        $hi = $n;
        while ($lo < $hi) {
            $mid = ($lo + $hi) >> 1;
            if ($flowers[$mid] >= $target) {
                $hi = $mid;
            } else {
                $lo = $mid + 1;
            }
        }
        $idx = $lo;

        $cap = $target - 1;
        $ans = 0;

        for ($k = 0; $k <= $idx; $k++) {
            $cost = $k * $target - ($pre[$idx] - $pre[$idx - $k]);
            if ($cost > $newFlowers) {
                break;
            }
            $rem = $newFlowers - $cost;
            $j = $idx - $k;

            if ($j == 0) {
                $minLevel = 0;
            } else {
                $lo = 0;
                $hi = $j;
                while ($lo < $hi) {
                    $mid = ($lo + $hi + 1) >> 1;
                    if ($mid < $j) {
                        $g = $mid * $flowers[$mid] - $pre[$mid];
                    } else {
                        $g = $j * $cap - $pre[$j];
                    }
                    if ($g <= $rem) {
                        $lo = $mid;
                    } else {
                        $hi = $mid - 1;
                    }
                }
                $t = $lo;
                if ($t == $j) {
                    $minLevel = $cap;
                } else {
                    $t1 = $t + 1;
                    $upper = ($t1 < $j) ? $flowers[$t1] : $cap;
                    $cand = intdiv($rem + $pre[$t1], $t1);
                    if ($cand > $upper) {
                        $cand = $upper;
                    }
                    if ($flowers[$t] > $cand) {
                        $cand = $flowers[$t];
                    }
                    $minLevel = $cand;
                }
            }

            $beauty = ($n - $j) * $full + $minLevel * $partial;
            if ($beauty > $ans) {
                $ans = $beauty;
            }
        }

        return $ans;
    }
}
```

```php
    /**
     * @param Integer[] $flowers
     * @param Integer $newFlowers
     * @param Integer $target
     * @param Integer $full
     * @param Integer $partial
     * @return Integer
     */
    function maximumBeauty($flowers, $newFlowers, $target, $full, $partial) {
        sort($flowers);
        $n = count($flowers);

        $pre = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $pre[$i + 1] = $pre[$i] + $flowers[$i];
        }

        // first index with flowers >= target (already complete gardens start here)
        $lo = 0;
        $hi = $n;
        while ($lo < $hi) {
            $mid = ($lo + $hi) >> 1;
            if ($flowers[$mid] >= $target) {
                $hi = $mid;
            } else {
                $lo = $mid + 1;
            }
        }
        $idx = $lo;

        $cap = $target - 1;
        $ans = 0;
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer[] $flowers
     * @param Integer $newFlowers
     * @param Integer $target
     * @param Integer $full
     * @param Integer $partial
     * @return Integer
     */
    function maximumBeauty($flowers, $newFlowers, $target, $full, $partial) {
        sort($flowers);
        $n = count($flowers);

        $pre = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $pre[$i + 1] = $pre[$i] + $flowers[$i];
        }

        $lo = 0;
        $hi = $n;
        while ($lo < $hi) {
            $mid = ($lo + $hi) >> 1;
            if ($flowers[$mid] >= $target) {
                $hi = $mid;
            } else {
                $lo = $mid + 1;
            }
        }
        $idx = $lo;

        $cap = $target - 1;
        $ans = 0;

        for ($k = 0; $k <= $idx; $k++) {
            $cost = $k * $target - ($pre[$idx] - $pre[$idx - $k]);
            if ($cost > $newFlowers) {
                break;
            }
            $rem = $newFlowers - $cost;
            $j = $idx - $k;

            if ($j == 0) {
                $minLevel = 0;
            } else {
                $lo = 0;
                $hi = $j;
                while ($lo < $hi) {
                    $mid = ($lo + $hi + 1) >> 1;
                    if ($mid < $j) {
                        $g = $mid * $flowers[$mid] - $pre[$mid];
                    } else {
                        $g = $j * $cap - $pre[$j];
                    }
                    if ($g <= $rem) {
                        $lo = $mid;
                    } else {
                        $hi = $mid - 1;
                    }
                }
                $t = $lo;
                if ($t == $j) {
                    $minLevel = $cap;
                } else {
                    $t1 = $t + 1;
                    $upper = ($t1 < $j) ? $flowers[$t1] : $cap;
                    $cand = intdiv($rem + $pre[$t1], $t1);
                    if ($cand > $upper) {
                        $cand = $upper;
                    }
                    if ($flowers[$t] > $cand) {
                        $cand = $flowers[$t];
                    }
                    $minLevel = $cand;
                }
            }

            $beauty = ($n - $j) * $full + $minLevel * $partial;
            if ($beauty > $ans) {
                $ans = $beauty;
            }
        }

        return $ans;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer[] $flowers
     * @param Integer $newFlowers
     * @param Integer $target
     * @param Integer $full
     * @param Integer $partial
     * @return Integer
     */
    function maximumBeauty($flowers, $newFlowers, $target, $full, $partial) {
        sort($flowers);
        $n = count($flowers);

        $pre = array_fill(0, $n + 1, 0);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $pre[$i + 1] = $pre[$i] + $flowers[$i];
        }

        $lo = 0;
        $hi = $n;
        while ($lo < $hi) {
            $mid = ($lo + $hi) >> 1;
            if ($flowers[$mid] >= $target) {
                $hi = $mid;
            } else {
                $lo = $mid + 1;
            }
        }
        $idx = $lo;

        $cap = $target - 1;
        $ans = 0;

        for ($k = 0; $k <= $idx; $k++) {
            $cost = $k * $target - ($pre[$idx] - $pre[$idx - $k]);
            if ($cost > $newFlowers) {
                break;
            }
            $rem = $newFlowers - $cost;
            $j = $idx - $k;

            if ($j == 0) {
                $minLevel = 0;
            } else {
                $lo = 0;
                $hi = $j;
                while ($lo < $hi) {
                    $mid = ($lo + $hi + 1) >> 1;
                    if ($mid < $j) {
                        $g = $mid * $flowers[$mid] - $pre[$mid];
                    } else {
                        $g = $j * $cap - $pre[$j];
                    }
                    if ($g <= $rem) {
                        $lo = $mid;
                    } else {
                        $hi = $mid - 1;
                    }
                }
                $t = $lo;
                if ($t == $j) {
                    $minLevel = $cap;
                } else {
                    $t1 = $t + 1;
                    $upper = ($t1 < $j) ? $flowers[$t1] : $cap;
                    $cand = intdiv($rem + $pre[$t1], $t1);
                    if ($cand > $upper) {
                        $cand = $upper;
                    }
                    if ($flowers[$t] > $cand) {
                        $cand = $flowers[$t];
                    }
                    $minLevel = $cand;
                }
            }

            $beauty = ($n - $j) * $full + $minLevel * $partial;
            if ($beauty > $ans) {
                $ans = $beauty;
            }
        }

        return $ans;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {
    /**
     * @param Integer[] $tasks
     * @param Integer $sessionTime
     * @return Integer
     */
    function minSessions($tasks, $sessionTime) {
        $n = count($tasks);
        $full = (1 << $n) - 1;
        $INF = PHP_INT_MAX;
        // dpS[mask], dpR[mask]
        $dpS = array_fill(0, 1 << $n, $INF);
        $dpR = array_fill(0, 1 << $n, 0);
        $dpS[0] = 0;
        $dpR[0] = 0;
        for ($mask = 0; $mask <= $full; $mask++) {
            if ($dpS[$mask] === $INF) continue; // unreachable — actually all masks reachable
            $s = $dpS[$mask]; $r = $dpR[$mask];
            for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
                $bit = 1 << $i;
                if ($mask & $bit) continue;
                $t = $tasks[$i];
                $nm = $mask | $bit;
                if ($t <= $r) {
                    $ns = $s; $nr = $r - $t;
                } else {
                    $ns = $s + 1; $nr = $sessionTime - $t;
                }
                if ($ns < $dpS[$nm] || ($ns == $dpS[$nm] && $nr > $dpR[$nm])) {
                    $dpS[$nm] = $ns;
                    $dpR[$nm] = $nr;
                }
            }
        }
        return $dpS[$full];
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer[] $tasks
     * @param Integer $sessionTime
     * @return Integer
     */
    function minSessions($tasks, $sessionTime) {
        $n = count($tasks);
        $size = 1 << $n;
        $full = $size - 1;

        $dpS = array_fill(0, $size, PHP_INT_MAX);
        $dpR = array_fill(0, $size, 0);

        $dpS[0] = 0;
        $dpR[0] = 0;

        for ($mask = 0; $mask < $size; $mask++) {
            if ($dpS[$mask] === PHP_INT_MAX) {
                continue;
            }
            $s = $dpS[$mask];
            $r = $dpR[$mask];
            for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
                $bit = 1 << $i;
                if (($mask & $bit) !== 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                $nm = $mask | $bit;
                $t = $tasks[$i];
                if ($t <= $r) {
                    $ns = $s;
                    $nr = $r - $t;
                } else {
                    $ns = $s + 1;
                    $nr = $sessionTime - $t;
                }
                if ($ns < $dpS[$nm] || ($ns === $dpS[$nm] && $nr > $dpR[$nm])) {
                    $dpS[$nm] = $ns;
                    $dpR[$nm] = $nr;
                }
            }
        }

        return $dpS[$full];
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer[] $tasks
     * @param Integer $sessionTime
     * @return Integer
     */
    function minSessions($tasks, $sessionTime) {
        $n = count($tasks);
        $size = 1 << $n;
        $full = $size - 1;
        $S = $sessionTime;

        $INF = PHP_INT_MAX;
        $dp = array_fill(0, $size, $INF);
        $dp[0] = $S; // s=0, used=S (r=0) → 0*16 + S

        for ($mask = 0; $mask < $size; $mask++) {
            $cur = $dp[$mask];
            if ($cur === $INF) continue;
            $s = intdiv($cur, 16);
            $used = $cur % 16;
            $r = $S - $used;
            for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
                $bit = 1 << $i;
                if ($mask & $bit) continue;
                $t = $tasks[$i];
                if ($t <= $r) {
                    $ns = $s;
                    $nused = $used + $t;
                } else {
                    $ns = $s + 1;
                    $nused = $S - $t;
                }
                $nm = $mask | $bit;
                $val = $ns * 16 + $nused;
                if ($val < $dp[$nm]) {
                    $dp[$nm] = $val;
                }
            }
        }

        return intdiv($dp[$full], 16);
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer[] $tasks
     * @param Integer $sessionTime
     * @return Integer
     */
    function minSessions($tasks, $sessionTime) {
        $n = count($tasks);
        $size = 1 << $n;
        $full = $size - 1;
        $INF = PHP_INT_MAX;

        $dpS = array_fill(0, $size, $INF); // min sessions
        $dpR = array_fill(0, $size, 0);    // max remaining time in current session (among min-session states)
        $dpS[0] = 0;
        $dpR[0] = 0;

        for ($mask = 0; $mask < $size; $mask++) {
            $s = $dpS[$mask];
            if ($s === $INF) continue;
            $r = $dpR[$mask];
            for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
                $bit = 1 << $i;
                if (($mask & $bit) !== 0) continue;
                $t = $tasks[$i];
                if ($t <= $r) {
                    $ns = $s;
                    $nr = $r - $t;
                } else {
                    $ns = $s + 1;
                    $nr = $sessionTime - $t;
                }
                $nm = $mask | $bit;
                if ($ns < $dpS[$nm] || ($ns === $dpS[$nm] && $nr > $dpR[$nm])) {
                    $dpS[$nm] = $ns;
                    $dpR[$nm] = $nr;
                }
            }
        }

        return $dpS[$full];
    }
}
```

```python
class DualHeap:
    def __init__(self, k: int):
        # 小根堆，维护较大的一半元素
        self.large = list()
        # 大根堆，维护较小的一半元素，注意 python 中没有大根堆，需要对元素取相反数
        self.small = list()
        # 哈希表，记录「延迟删除」的元素，key 为元素，value 为需要删除的次数
        self.delayed = collections.Counter()
        self.k = k
        # small 和 large 当前包含的元素个数，需要扣除被「延迟删除」的元素
        self.smallSize = 0
        self.largeSize = 0

    def prune(self, heap: list) -> None:
        while heap:
            num = heap[0] if heap is self.large else -heap[0]
            if num in self.delayed:
                self.delayed[num] -= 1
                if self.delayed[num] == 0:
                    del self.delayed[num]
                heapq.heappop(heap)
            else:
                break

    def makeBalance(self) -> None:
        # 调整 small 和 large 中的元素个数，使得二者的元素个数满足要求
        if self.smallSize > self.largeSize + 1:
            # small 中的元素比 large 中的元素多 2 个
            self.prune(self.small)
            num = -heapq.heappop(self.small)
            heapq.heappush(self.large, num)
            self.smallSize -= 1
            self.largeSize += 1
            # pop 和 push 操作结束后，heap 堆顶元素是有效值，取出来存入 num
            self.prune(self.large)
        elif self.smallSize < self.largeSize:
            # small 中的元素比 large 中的元素少 1 个
            self.prune(self.large)
            num = heapq.heappop(self.large)
            heapq.heappush(self.small, -num)
            self.smallSize += 1
            self.largeSize -= 1
            self.prune(self.small)

    def insert(self, num: int) -> None:
        if not self.small or num <= -self.small[0]:
            heapq.heappush(self.small, -num)
            self.smallSize += 1
        else:
            heapq.heappush(self.large, num)
            self.largeSize += 1
        self.makeBalance()

    def erase(self, num: int) -> None:
        self.delayed[num] += 1
        if num <= -self.small[0]:
            self.smallSize -= 1
            if num == -self.small[0]:
                self.prune(self.small)
        else:
            self.largeSize -= 1
            if num == self.large[0]:
                self.prune(self.large)
        self.makeBalance()

    def getMedian(self) -> float:
        median = -self.small[0] if self.k % 2 == 1 else (-self.small[0] + self.large[0]) / 2
        return median
```

```python
class DualHeap:
    def __init__(self, k: int):
        self.small = []  # 大根堆，维护较小的一半
        self.large = []  # 小根堆，维护较大的一半
        self.delayed = collections.Counter()
        self.k = k
        self.smallSize = 0
        self.largeSize = 0

    def prune(self, heap) -> None:
        while heap:
            num = heap[0] if heap is self.large else -heap[0]
            if num in self.delayed:
                self.delayed[num] -= 1
                if self.delayed[num] == 0:
                    del self.delayed[num]
                heapq.heappop(heap)
            else:
                break

    def makeBalance(self) -> None:
        if self.smallSize > self.largeSize + 1:
            self.prune(self.small)
            num = -heapq.heappop(self.small)
            heapq.heappush(self.large, num)
            self.smallSize -= 1
            self.largeSize += 1
            self.prune(self.large)
        elif self.smallSize < self.largeSize:
            self.prune(self.large)
            num = heapq.heappop(self.large)
            heapq.heappush(self.small, -num)
            self.smallSize += 1
            self.largeSize -= 1
            self.prune(self.small)

    def insert(self, num: int) -> None:
        if not self.small or num <= -self.small[0]:
            heapq.heappush(self.small, -num)
            self.smallSize += 1
        else:
            heapq.heappush(self.large, num)
            self.largeSize += 1
        self.makeBalance()

    def erase(self, num: int) -> None:
        self.delayed[num] += 1
        if num <= -self.small[0]:
            self.smallSize -= 1
            if num == -self.small[0]:
                self.prune(self.small)
        else:
            self.largeSize -= 1
            if num == self.large[0]:
                self.prune(self.large)
        self.makeBalance()

    def getMedian(self) -> float:
        median = -self.small[0] if self.k % 2 == 1 else (-self.small[0] + self.large[0]) / 2
        return median
```

```php
            for (; $j <= $m; $j += ($j & -$j)) $tree[$j]++;

                $j = $pos[$nums[$i - $k]] + 1;
                for (; $j <= $m; $j += ($j & -$j)) $tree[$j]--;
            }
            
            if ($i >= $k - 1) {
                if ($k & 1) {
                    $r = ($k + 1) >> 1;
                    $ans[] = (float)$vals[$this->kth($tree, $m, $LOG, $r)];
                } else {
                    $h = $k >> 1;
                    $a = $vals[$this->kth($tree, $m, $LOG, $h)];
                    $b = $vals[$this->kth($tree, $m, $LOG, $h + 1)];
                    $ans[] = ((float)$a + (float)$b) / 2.0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return $ans;
    }
    
    private function kth($tree, $m, $LOG, $r) {
        $pos = 0;
        $rem = $r;
        for ($pw = $LOG; $pw >= 1; $pw >>= 1) {
            $nxt = $pos + $pw;
            if ($nxt <= $m && $tree[$nxt] < $rem) {
                $pos = $nxt;
                $rem -= $tree[$nxt];
            }
        }
        return $pos;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {

    /**
     * @param Integer[] $nums
     * @param Integer $k
     * @return Float[]
     */
    function medianSlidingWindow($nums, $k) {
        $n = count($nums);

        // Coordinate compression
        $vals = array_values(array_unique($nums));
        sort($vals);
        $m = count($vals);
        $pos = array_flip($vals);

        // Fenwick tree (1-indexed counts)
        $tree = array_fill(0, $m + 1, 0);

        // Highest power of two <= m (for kth binary lifting)
        $log = 1;
        while (($log << 1) <= $m) {
            $log <<= 1;
        }

        $ans = [];

        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            // Insert nums[i]
            $j = $pos[$nums[$i]] + 1;
            for (; $j <= $m; $j += ($j & -$j)) {
                $tree[$j]++;
            }

            // Remove outgoing element
            if ($i >= $k) {
                $j = $pos[$nums[$i - $k]] + 1;
                for (; $j <= $m; $j += ($j & -$j)) {
                    $tree[$j]--;
                }
            }

            // Window [i-k+1, i] is complete
            if ($i >= $k - 1) {
                if ($k & 1) {
                    $ans[] = (float)$vals[$this->kthIndex($tree, $m, $log, ($k + 1) >> 1)];
                } else {
                    $half = $k >> 1;
                    $a = (float)$vals[$this->kthIndex($tree, $m, $log, $half)];
                    $b = (float)$vals[$this->kthIndex($tree, $m, $log, $half + 1)];
                    $ans[] = ($a + $b) / 2.0;
                }
            }
        }

        return $ans;
    }

    /**
     * Index (0-based) of the r-th smallest (1-indexed r) element in the multiset
     * tracked by the Fenwick tree.
     */
    private function kthIndex($tree, $m, $log, $r) {
        $idx = 0;
        $rem = $r;
        for ($pw = $log; $pw > 0; $pw >>= 1) {
            $nxt = $idx + $pw;
            if ($nxt <= $m && $tree[$nxt] < $rem) {
                $idx = $nxt;
                $rem -= $tree[$nxt];
            }
        }
        return $idx;
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {
    private array $memo;
    
    function earliestAndLatest($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer) {
        // memo[m][i][j] = [e, l] or null
        $this->memo = [];
        [$e, $l] = $this->solve($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer);
        return [$e, $l];
    }
    
    private function solve(int $m, int $i, int $j): array {
        if ($j == $m + 1 - $i) return [1, 1];
        $key = ($m << 10) | ($i << 5) | $j; // m up to 28 (5 bits), i,j up to 28 (5 bits)
        if (isset($this->memo[$key])) return $this->memo[$key];
        
        $h = intdiv($m, 2);
        $mid = $m % 2;
        $hh = $h + $mid; // ceil(m/2)
        $mp = $h + 1; // middle position (valid if mid==1)
        
        $eBest = PHP_INT_MAX;
        $lBest = 0;
        
        $explore = function(int $nm, int $ni, int $nj) use (&$explore, &$eBest, &$lBest) {
            [$e, $l] = $this->solve($nm, $ni, $nj);
            if ($e < $eBest) $eBest = $e;
            if ($l > $lBest) $lBest = $l;
        };
        
        if ($j <= $hh) {
            // Case A: second is low or middle; first is low
            $nm = $hh;
            for ($a = 0; $a <= $i - 1; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b <= $j - $i - 1; $b++) {
                    $explore($nm, 1 + $a, 2 + $a + $b);
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i <= $h) {
            // Case B1: first low, second high
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            $nm = $h + $mid;
            if ($p < $i) {
                for ($a1 = 0; $a1 <= $p - 1; $a1++) {
                    for ($a2 = 0; $a2 <= $i - 1 - $p; $a2++) {
                        $explore($nm, 1 + $a1 + $a2, $a1 + $h - $p + $mid + 1);
                    }
                }
            } else { // p > i
                for ($a = 0; $a <= $i - 1; $a++) {
                    for ($l1 = 0; $l1 <= $p - $i - 1; $l1++) {
                        $explore($nm, 1 + $a, $a + $h - $p + $l1 + $mid + 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        } elseif ($mid == 1 && $i == $h + 1) {
            // Case B2: first is middle, second high
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            $nm = $h + 1;
            for ($a1 = 0; $a1 <= $p - 1; $a1++) {
                for ($l2 = 0; $l2 <= $h - $p; $l2++) {
                    $explore($nm, $a1 + $l2 + 1, $a1 + $h - $p + 2);
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Case C: both high
            $nm = $h + $mid;
            // p_i = m+1-i, p_j = m+1-j; a in [0, m-j], b in [0, j-i-1]
            for ($a = 0; $a <= $m - $j; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b <= $j - $i - 1; $b++) {
                    $explore($nm, $a + $b + $i - $h, $a + $j - $h);
                }
            }
        }
        
        return $this->memo[$key] = [$eBest, $lBest];
    }
```

```php
class Solution {
    private array $memo = [];

    /**
     * @param Integer $n
     * @param Integer $firstPlayer
     * @param Integer $secondPlayer
     * @return Integer[]
     */
    function earliestAndLatest($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer) {
        return $this->solve($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer);
    }

    private function solve(int $m, int $i, int $j): array {
        if ($j == $m + 1 - $i) {
            return [1, 1];
        }
        $key = $m * 1024 + $i * 32 + $j;
        if (isset($this->memo[$key])) {
            return $this->memo[$key];
        }

        $h = intdiv($m, 2);
        $mid = $m % 2;
        $hh = $h + $mid; // ceil(m/2)

        $eBest = PHP_INT_MAX;
        $lBest = 0;

        if ($j <= $hh) {
            // Case A: second is low or middle (first is low)
            $nm = $hh;
            for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b < $j - $i; $b++) {
                    $this->upd($eBest, $lBest, $nm, 1 + $a, 2 + $a + $b);
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i <= $h) {
            // Case B1: first low, second high
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            $nm = $h + $mid;
            if ($p < $i) {
                for ($a1 = 0; $a1 < $p; $a1++) {
                    for ($a2 = 0; $a2 <= $i - 1 - $p; $a2++) {
                        $this->upd($eBest, $lBest, $nm, 1 + $a1 + $a2, $a1 + $h - $p + $mid + 1);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                    for ($l1 = 0; $l1 <= $p - $i - 1; $l1++) {
                        $this->upd($eBest, $lBest, $nm, 1 + $a, $a + $h - $p + $l1 + $mid + 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        } elseif ($mid == 1 && $i == $h + 1) {
            // Case B2: first is middle, second high
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
```

```php
class Solution {
    private array $memo = [];

    function earliestAndLatest($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer) {
        return $this->solve((int)$n, (int)$firstPlayer, (int)$secondPlayer);
    }

    private function solve(int $m, int $i, int $j): array {
        if ($j == $m + 1 - $i) return [1, 1];
        $key = $m * 1024 + $i * 32 + $j;
        if (isset($this->memo[$key])) return $this->memo[$key];

        $h = intdiv($m, 2);
        $mid = $m % 2;
        $hh = $h + $mid;

        $e = PHP_INT_MAX;
        $l = 0;

        if ($j <= $hh) {
            // second in first half (or middle); first is low
            for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b < $j - $i; $b++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + 1, $a + $b + 2);
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i <= $h) {
            // first low, second high
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            if ($p < $i) {
                for ($a1 = 0; $a1 < $p; $a1++) {
                    for ($a2 = 0; $a2 <= $i - $p - 1; $a2++) {
                        $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a1 + $a2 + 1, $a1 + $h - $p + $mid + 1);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                    for ($c = 0; $c <= $p - $i - 1; $c++) {
                        $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + 1, $a + $h - $p + $c + $mid + 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i == $hh) {
            // first is the middle player (m odd), second high
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            for ($a1 = 0; $a1 < $p; $a1++) {
                for ($c = 0; $c <= $h - $p; $c++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $h + 1, $a1 + $c + 1, $a1 + $h - $p + 2);
                }
            }
        } else {
            // both high
            for ($a = 0; $a <= $m - $j; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b < $j - $i; $b++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + $b + $i - $h, $a + $j - $h);
                }
            }
        }

        return $this->memo[$key] = [$e, $l];
    }

    private function upd(&$e, &$l, int $m, int $i, int $j): void {
        $r = $this->solve($m, $i, $j);
        if ($r[0] < $e) $e = $r[0];
        if ($r[1] > $l) $l = $r[1];
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {
    private $memo = [];

    /**
     * @param Integer $n
     * @param Integer $firstPlayer
     * @param Integer $secondPlayer
     * @return Integer[]
     */
    function earliestAndLatest($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer) {
        return $this->solve($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer);
    }

    private function solve($m, $i, $j) {
        if ($j == $m + 1 - $i) return [1, 1];
        if (isset($this->memo[$m][$i][$j])) return $this->memo[$m][$i][$j];

        $h = intdiv($m, 2);
        $mid = $m % 2;
        $hh = $h + $mid; // ceil(m/2)

        $e = PHP_INT_MAX;
        $l = 0;

        if ($j <= $hh) {
            // Second player is in the low half (or is the middle).
            // First player is low; both survive as lows.
            for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b < $j - $i; $b++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + 1, $a + $b + 2);
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i <= $h) {
            // First low, second high.
            $p = $m + 1 - $j; // second's pair index
            if ($p < $i) {
                for ($a1 = 0; $a1 < $p; $a1++) {
                    for ($a2 = 0; $a2 <= $i - $p - 1; $a2++) {
                        $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a1 + $a2 + 1, $a1 + $h - $p + $mid + 1);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                    for ($c = 0; $c <= $p - $i - 1; $c++) {
                        $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + 1, $a + $h - $p + $c + $mid + 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i == $hh) {
            // First is the middle player (m odd), second high.
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            for ($a1 = 0; $a1 < $p; $a1++) {
                for ($c = 0; $c <= $h - $p; $c++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $h + 1, $a1 + $c + 1, $a1 + $h - $p + 2);
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Both high.
            for ($a = 0; $a <= $m - $j; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b < $j - $i; $b++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + $b + $i - $h, $a + $j - $h);
                }
            }
        }

        $this->memo[$m][$i][$j] = [$e, $l];
        return $this->memo[$m][$i][$j];
    }

    private function upd(&$e, &$l, $m, $i, $j) {
        $r = $this->solve($m, $i, $j);
        if ($r[0] < $e) $e = $r[0];
        if ($r[1] > $l) $l = $r[1];
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {
    private $memo = [];

    /**
     * @param Integer $n
     * @param Integer $firstPlayer
     * @param Integer $secondPlayer
     * @return Integer[]
     */
    function earliestAndLatest($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer) {
        return $this->solve($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer);
    }

    private function solve($m, $i, $j) {
        if ($j == $m + 1 - $i) {
            return [1, 1];
        }
        if (isset($this->memo[$m][$i][$j])) {
            return $this->memo[$m][$i][$j];
        }

        $h = intdiv($m, 2);
        $mid = $m % 2;
        $hh = $h + $mid; // ceil(m/2): size of next round

        $e = PHP_INT_MAX;
        $l = 0;

        if ($j <= $hh) {
            // second is in the low half or is the middle; first is low
            for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b < $j - $i; $b++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + 1, $a + $b + 2);
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i <= $h) {
            // first low, second high
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            if ($p < $i) {
                for ($a1 = 0; $a1 < $p; $a1++) {
                    for ($a2 = 0; $a2 <= $i - $p - 1; $a2++) {
                        $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a1 + $a2 + 1, $a1 + $h - $p + $mid + 1);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                    for ($c = 0; $c <= $p - $i - 1; $c++) {
                        $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + 1, $a + $h - $p + $c + $mid + 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i == $hh) {
            // first is the middle (m odd), second high
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            for ($a1 = 0; $a1 < $p; $a1++) {
                for ($c = 0; $c <= $h - $p; $c++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $h + 1, $a1 + $c + 1, $a1 + $h - $p + 2);
                }
            }
        } else {
            // both high
            for ($a = 0; $a <= $m - $j; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b < $j - $i; $b++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + $b + $i - $h, $a + $j - $h);
                }
            }
        }

        return $this->memo[$m][$i][$j] = [$e, $l];
    }

    private function upd(&$e, &$l, $m, $i, $j) {
        $r = $this->solve($m, $i, $j);
        if ($r[0] < $e) $e = $r[0];
        if ($r[1] > $l) $l = $r[1];
    }
}
```

```php
class Solution {
    private $memo = [];

    /**
     * @param Integer $n
     * @param Integer $firstPlayer
     * @param Integer $secondPlayer
     * @return Integer[]
     */
    function earliestAndLatest($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer) {
        return $this->solve($n, $firstPlayer, $secondPlayer);
    }

    /**
     * State: current round has $m players (sorted by original number),
     * firstPlayer sits at position $i, secondPlayer at position $j (1-indexed).
     * Returns [earliest, latest] number of rounds (counting the current one)
     * until they meet. Other players are interchangeable, so (m, i, j) is a
     * sufficient state description.
     */
    private function solve($m, $i, $j) {
        if ($j == $m + 1 - $i) { // they are paired this round
            return [1, 1];
        }
        if (isset($this->memo[$m][$i][$j])) {
            return $this->memo[$m][$i][$j];
        }

        $h = intdiv($m, 2);   // number of pairs
        $mid = $m % 2;        // 1 if there is a middle player
        $hh = $h + $mid;      // ceil(m/2) = size of next round

        $e = PHP_INT_MAX;
        $l = 0;

        if ($j <= $hh) {
            // second is in the low half (or is the middle player); first is low.
            // Both survive as "lows". Free pairs before i contribute $a lows,
            // free pairs between i and j contribute $b lows.
            for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b < $j - $i; $b++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + 1, $a + $b + 2);
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i <= $h) {
            // first is low, second is high; p = index of second's pair.
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            if ($p < $i) {
                // second's pair lies before first's pair.
                for ($a1 = 0; $a1 < $p; $a1++) {
                    for ($a2 = 0; $a2 <= $i - $p - 1; $a2++) {
                        $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a1 + $a2 + 1, $a1 + $h - $p + $mid + 1);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for ($a = 0; $a < $i; $a++) {
                    for ($c = 0; $c <= $p - $i - 1; $c++) {
                        $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + 1, $a + $h - $p + $c + $mid + 2);
                    }
                }
            }
        } elseif ($i == $hh) {
            // first is the middle player (m odd), second is high.
            $p = $m + 1 - $j;
            for ($a1 = 0; $a1 < $p; $a1++) {
                for ($c = 0; $c <= $h - $p; $c++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $h + 1, $a1 + $c + 1, $a1 + $h - $p + 2);
                }
            }
        } else {
            // both are high; p_i > p_j are their pair indices.
            for ($a = 0; $a <= $m - $j; $a++) {
                for ($b = 0; $b < $j - $i; $b++) {
                    $this->upd($e, $l, $hh, $a + $b + $i - $h, $a + $j - $h);
                }
            }
        }

        return $this->memo[$m][$i][$j] = [$e, $l];
    }

    private function upd(&$e, &$l, $m, $i, $j) {
        $r = $this->solve($m, $i, $j);
        if ($r[0] < $e) $e = $r[0];
        if ($r[1] > $l) $l = $r[1];
    }
}
```
